rationale: Bring the vote-durability question's knowledge citation to the revision its interpretation now uses. The batch-ordering entry is revision 2, which keeps the release ordering and adds the completion condition for readiness signals; the question still cited revision 1. Restating the use at revision 2 keeps the index and the account on the same premise. No question text, disposition or interpretation changes.

knowledge.assertion: Non-free-order messages, including RequestVoteResp and HeartbeatResp, are forwarded only after the batch's raft state has been committed atomically.
The batch loop releases the readiness signals before SaveRaftState but sends vote responses only after it, and a read batch completes only when the applied index reaches its ready index.
